description: Header file for Data Encryption Unit driver, defining constants, data structures, and function prototypes for cryptographic hardware initialization and control on MIPS architecture.

classes.name: deu_drv_priv_t
classes.description: Private data structure for Data Encryption Unit driver, managing event flags, buffers, and pointers to AES and DES private data.

classes.name: aes_priv_t
classes.description: Private data structure for asynchronous AES operations, including locks, queues, status, and task management.

classes.name: des_priv_t
classes.description: Private data structure for asynchronous DES operations, including locks, queues, status, and task management.

methods.name: ltq_pmu_enable

methods.name: ltq_pmu_disable
methods.description: Disables power management unit for DEU.

methods.name: wait_event_interruptible_timeout
methods.description: Waits for an event with timeout, interruptible.

methods.description: Clears a specific bit in a flags variable.

methods.name: set_bit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a flags variable.

methods.name: wake_up_interruptible
methods.description: Wakes up processes waiting on an interruptible wait queue.

methods.name: spin_lock_irqsave
methods.description: Acquires a spinlock and saves interrupt flags.

methods.name: spin_unlock_irqrestore
methods.description: Releases a spinlock and restores interrupt flags.
